name: compress.zlib
doc:
zlib streams (RFC 1950): a 2-byte header, raw DEFLATE, the Adler-32 of
the data (big-endian). Preset dictionaries are not supported.

items.name: Decompress
items.doc: Decompresses one complete zlib stream (trailing bytes are an error).
items.summary: Decompresses one complete zlib stream (trailing bytes are an error).

items.name: NewWriter
items.doc: NewWriter returns a compressor with level (0-9, -1 for the default).
items.summary: NewWriter returns a compressor with level (0-9, -1 for the default).

items.name: Reader
items.doc:
A streaming zlib decompressor (see deflate.Reader); the checksum is
verified when the stream ends.
items.summary: A streaming zlib decompressor (see deflate.Reader); the checksum is verified when the stream ends.

members.name: Feed
members.doc: Feed decompresses the next chunk of input; bytes after the stream are kept for Rest.
members.summary: Feed decompresses the next chunk of input; bytes after the stream are kept for Rest.

members.name: Read
members.doc: The decompressed bytes produced since the last call.
members.summary: The decompressed bytes produced since the last call.

members.name: Done
members.doc: True once the trailer was read and verified.
members.summary: True once the trailer was read and verified.

members.name: Rest
members.doc: Rest returns the input that followed the end of the stream.
members.summary: Rest returns the input that followed the end of the stream.

members.name: Close
members.doc: Close fails if the stream did not end.
members.summary: Close fails if the stream did not end.

members.name: Write
members.doc: Write compresses p (writing the header first).
members.summary: Write compresses p (writing the header first).

members.name: WriteString
members.doc: WriteString compresses the bytes of s.
members.summary: WriteString compresses the bytes of s.

members.name: Flush
members.doc: Flush emits everything written so far (a deflate sync flush).
members.summary: Flush emits everything written so far (a deflate sync flush).

members.name: Close
members.doc: Close finishes the stream and appends the Adler-32 trailer.
members.summary: Close finishes the stream and appends the Adler-32 trailer.

members.name: Bytes
members.doc: The compressed bytes produced since the last call.
members.summary: The compressed bytes produced since the last call.
